sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Settings page consists of three tabs: General, Titles and Institutions. From these tabs you manage the app's branding and the reference data used in the New User / signature flow.

sections.heading: General Tab
paragraphs: Company name, sidebar abbreviation, logo, email notification sender name, allowed sign-in domain and the app language are set here. The Google Service Account and Domain-Wide Delegation configuration is also on this tab.

callout.text: When branding info is changed, the sidebar and header update instantly; the same app is adapted to different organizations from this tab.

sections.heading: Titles Tab
paragraphs: Manage the list of titles that can be assigned to users (Manager, Teacher, etc.) here, and bulk-import them via CSV. Defined titles are selected on the New User page and used in the signature template as the {{unvan}} variable.

sections.heading: Institutions Tab
paragraphs: Each institution's name, address and phone are defined here. Defined institutions are selected on the New User page and appear in the signature template as the {{kurum_adi}}, {{kurum_adres}} and {{kurum_telefon}} variables. Bulk import via CSV is supported.

callout.text: The Institutions feature is meant for organizations with multiple branches or locations. Each branch/location is defined as a separate institution, so every user's signature carries their own branch details. Single-location companies can define just one institution.
